events.title: St. Francis hears the call to apostolic life
events.shortBlurb: At a little chapel near Assisi the young Francis heard the Gospel of the mission and resolved to live it to the letter…
body: On 24 February 1208, the feast of St. Matthias, the young Francis of Assisi was hearing Mass at the little chapel of the Portiuncula when the Gospel of the sending of the Apostles was read: that they should take neither gold nor silver, nor scrip, nor two coats, nor shoes, nor staff, but preach the kingdom of God. Francis, who had already turned from his father’s wealth, heard the words as spoken to himself and cried, “This is what I wish, this is what I seek, this is what I long to do with all my heart.”

Casting off his shoes and staff and girding himself with a rope, he began to preach penance and peace in poverty, and companions soon gathered to him. From that hour grew the Order of Friars Minor, whose rule Pope Innocent III approved the following year.

sources.text: Thomas of Celano, First Life of St. Francis (public-domain translation)
